tools.name: get_service_availability
tools.description: Check whether Detritus serves a US ZIP code and list the dumpster sizes, portable sanitation products, disposal materials, and other jobsite services (temporary fencing, storage containers, water, power) available there. Read-only.

tools.name: make_service_request
tools.description: Submit one quote request to Detritus for dumpster, portable sanitation, and/or other jobsite services. All items for one job go in a single request and produce a single quote. tools.description: Get the status of an existing Detritus quote request (received, assigned, building, sent). Requires serviceRequestId and the phone or email used on the request. tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get the customer-facing quote for an existing Detritus request: totals, price breakdown by product type, and quote link. Requires serviceRequestId and the phone or email used on the request. Returns customer pricing only (no vendor cost). Read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_service_request_status, get_quote · Private data: make_service_request · Public sink: make_service_request, check_service_request_status, get_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_service_request_status, get_quote · Private data: make_service_request · Public sink: make_service_request, check_service_request_status, get_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
